entries.title: A pinned task brings its parts into Pinned
entries.body: When you pin a task that has parts, they now list under it in the Pinned section of Tasks instead of staying scattered in their own groups. The parts themselves stay unpinned: unpin the task and each one goes back under its state. The Tasks tab on your phone shows the same.

picture.alt: The Tasks panel with a pinned task in Pinned and its three parts indented under it, while an unrelated task stays in Working
